facts.label: Status
facts.value: MVP built, then paused by the client

brief.title: The brief
text: Goaleadors was planned as a universal fantasy football game across England, Spain, Italy, Germany and France, free to play with a premium tier and a prize fund.
Players start in a base competition and climb a pyramid of leagues, from the fourth league up to the first.

contributions.title: What I did
items: Built the MVP for Android and iOS.
Built the admin panel behind it.
Implemented the squad, matchday scoring and the league structure for free and premium play.

items.title: Everyone starts here
items.text: The open competition for all players.

items.title: Climb
items.text: Eight fourth leagues, four third leagues and two second leagues.

items.title: The top
items.text: One first league at the peak, with the premium prize pool.

team.title: Team
team.text: I built the app myself, working directly with the client.

outcome.title: The result
outcome.text: The MVP was built on Android, iOS and the admin side; the client then paused the product.
